blocks.text: Trust Korina Sanchez to find ways on how to reinvent herself everytime she feels the change in the wind. From being a production assistant to becoming a writer/producer, a weather girl before moving up to news anchoring, Sanchez has mastered broadcast journalism, but has found her calling to doing talk shows, among many other advocacies.
